thread:
sara (Billing): Heads up 52 - nightly billing run invoice_batch_20260322 produced ~9 invoices where the VAT/sales tax line is present in summary but missing from line-items. Example: invoice 20260322-NOVA-12 shows total 1,200.00 but VAT 200.00 only in summary, not as a separate line.

nikhil (Billing Eng): repro'd locally. renderer returns subtotal + tax_total but render_lines() drops tax when tax_code lookup fails. suspect recent tax_rates table reload.

kevin (SRE): I see spikes in DB connection errors right at 02:58:31Z from the tax-service pod. There are a few 503s at the same time as the billing-run.

nikhil (Billing Eng): snippet from rendering trace: 

```
WARN Renderer: tax_code lookup returned null for tenant=214
File: render_lines.py:142
if tax_code and tax_code != 'EXEMPT': lines.append({ 'desc': 'VAT', 'amount': tax_total})
```

This logic silently drops the VAT line when tax_code is missing. Need to change to include an explicit fallback line if tax_total > 0.

sara (Billing): also noticed two customers got duplicate invoice numbers (same invoice_id) but different net totals. likely from retry + partial write race. example: 20260322-ORCH-55 appears twice.

ella (Accounting): downstream ledger importer fails for missing tax lines; our tax liability numbers for March look off. We need an export of affected invoice records before we reissue anything.

nikhil (Billing Eng): proposed immediate fix: 1) change renderer to add VAT line when tax_total > 0 regardless of tax_code presence; 2) patch idempotency in pdf-creation to use object-store atomic put-if-absent; 3) backfill affected invoices by re-running invoice_renderer in dry-run first and produce a reconciliation CSV. I'll open PR #4241.

kevin (SRE): To avoid extra noise I'll pause automatic requeueing for invoice_batch_20260322 and hold a short maintenance window for the dedupe work. I'll also increase replica count for tax-service to reduce 503 flaps.

tom (Legal): quick question: if we change line wording ("VAT" -> "Sales Tax"), do we need new approvals for country-specific wording? Could affect EU customers.

sara (Billing): good point. keep wording unchanged for now. nik, make fallback line text match existing locale logic. We'll loop in Legal if we need wording changes per region.

nikhil (Billing Eng): patch checklist: unit tests for tax fallback, integration test against tax-service failure mode, add metrics when renderer drops a tax line. ETA 1h for deploy to staging, 3h to prod if no regression.

ella (Accounting): please include fields in CSV: invoice_id, customer_id, gross_total, tax_total, missing_line_flag, original_pdf_url. We will validate GL entries and hold any clearing entries until reconciled.

sara (Billing): I'll prepare customer comms template for those who saw duplicate invoices. We'll only send after dedupe and canonical re-render.

finance-bot: Automated alert: invoice_batch_20260322: 9 missing-tax-line renders, 2 duplicate invoice_ids detected, paused automated requeues.

kevin (SRE): scheduled maintenance window for dedupe/re-render: 2026-03-22 04:30-05:00 UTC. I'll post calendar invite and update runbook.

nikhil (Billing Eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/billing/pulls/4241. Running tests now.

sara (Billing): thanks. once PR merges, run a dry re-render for affected invoices and attach CSV to this thread. :white_check_mark:
